notes.title: Brand New Content Update: LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/19a36d5cfb68dbab8f81489518d4d0dc54fd976e.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that Die After Sunset has just received a brand-new update today on Steam! 🚀✨ Get ready for all-new changes including: 

🎯 New Shooting Mechanics 
💃 New Player Animations
🎓 New Tutorial Level 
🎥 Boss Cutscenes Added
📊 New HUD 
🏹 New Missions 
🐞 Bug Fixes & Balancing 
🌟 And More!

We've been working on this update for a while now & would like to thank everyone who helped beta test and tweak these latest changes. Keep your eyes peeled for more in the future! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ef8f892476fbc867bfdcd1d4151e70112560ef00.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/58eb7604ed4a9951e906a4c043d189a8758c9fe8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/eb085934dc0a40e57a735725aad6fe70447e2701.gif[/img]

There are 3 large boxes of dynamite, all connected to very long lines of rope. These are being lit up by the Murkers and your job is to protect the area to make sure they don't reignite it. 

Although it is only 1 minute, they will swarm the area and you must make sure to not get carried away removing the Murkers. they might of lit up one of the detonating cords.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/6d5dc4ee247e17680f00acc0818e6a4544b9c675.gif[/img]

After 1 minute much like every other mission, you are rewarded depending on how many boxes of dynamite has been detonated. A simple yet a cluster of fun to be had with this mission and another mission in the our pool of RNG missions to keep your gameplay fresh.

[h3]Die After Sunset is 25% off today as part of the new update, buy now and experience it for yourself![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1440010/Die_After_Sunset/

notes.title: Die After Sunset New Mission - Shootout
notes.content:
[b]Welcome Back Defenders![/b]

We have a great  variety of missions that randomises in each level and play through. But we're happy to give you a sneak peak to a brand new mission coming very soon - Shootout!

[h3][b]WHAT DO I DO?[/b][/h3]
The mission can be found much like any other activity on the map. Which means luck will be involved, as all the missions are randomly generated. Once you have found the mission, approach the saloon bar and prepare to shoot some of those darn Murkors. Each Murkor you shoot will achieve points, 15 or 30 points to be exact. 

And yes, even your friendly helpers can shoot the Murkors too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/b5c185e40f9040f82892db902b953ccb42464ab9.gif[/img]

[h3][b]IS IT THAT EASY?[/b][/h3]

Well not entirely. Some of us might be hitting bullseyes all the time, but you have to be careful not to shoot the dynamite which might pop up time to time. These will reduce 100 points that you earned so be careful!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/dd7ce5f5dd8c60fd0133d70ead76c7ff1597fb30.png[/img]

With heavy losses comes with great rewards. We will rarely pop up a few moneybags as well as the Murkors. If you shoot at these bags will reward you with 100 points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/1c3ecaeadb74154cbc268d640846c1e4f46692fd.png[/img]

[h3][b]WHAT'S NEXT? [/b][/h3]

Once the timer is over, you will receive your prize depending on what score you get. The higher the score the more prizes is received. 

Of course this isn't the only mission we have been working on so stick around!

notes.title: Die After Sunset Road To 1.0 - Player Animations
notes.content:
It's that time again defenders for some more [b]UPDATES![/b]

Last time we looked at the enemy reactions and how they change based on the players actions. Now it is  time to look at the characters animations!

[h3][b]NEW IDLE ANIMATIONS[/b][/h3]
One way to give our characters some more personality is to add some idle animations. These are triggered if you wait around for a while without moving, which will be relatively difficult considering Murkers will be chasing you a lot! 

However, when you can activate these animations they really make the character feel more.....well human. This has been implemented to April, Hune and of course Rido as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/49ee262819200921f10ccf32f384af3dc4dfc6a1.gif[/img]

[h3][b]NEW CHEST ANIMATION[/b][/h3]
Gone of the days where a box will magically open from a touch of a button. We have applied a new animation where the character will now crouch to unlock the box. It's the little things that increases our immersion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/2f2dcbbdabeec8549981ef9384fb961717cf39a2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]CHARACTER'S HEAD FOLLOWS THE CAMERA[/b][/h3]
To help build on a more immersive 3rd person experience we felt it is really important to implement head movement depending on where you put your camera. This small feature makes the character feel more alive and helps align when your are dealing with those pesky Murkers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/7091e0427b7a658593ffedb93c197cdb56cb66c1.gif[/img]
This is just the start of all small changes that we are making in the road to 1.0 and we are excited to show you more.

[b]Stay Tuned![/b]

notes.title: Die After Sunset Road To 1.0 - Enemy Reactions
notes.content:
[h2][b]Nice to see you back defenders![/b][/h2]

The Murkors are a large part of our game with so many different designs and characteristics. We felt like it was important to provide these little devils with some more personality. While we are changing up the enemies behaviour and weaponry,  we would first like to show you an overhaul of new animations when they react to the players actions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/95135dd94f64eab8c0d62299a372fa2b26282cb1.gif[/img]


[h3][b]THEY REALLY DON'T LIKE YOU NOW![/b][/h3]

We felt like the Murkors didn't show enough emotion when they are literally being shot at and seeing a heroic protagonist lay rest to there friends. So we have decided to make them more angrier than before. when you shoot or approach a Murkor, they can show their displeasure to you now, showing that your presence is not amusing to them at all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/c2e35f5c56c878039300f1e1309f651ba32b9863.png[/img]


[h3][b]ABILITIES WILL SHOW AN EFFECT[/b][/h3]

There are many different weapons and equipment that you will have at your disposal and each item will make the Murkor react to it. For example if you throw a stun grenade at some Murkors they will look classically confused and disorientated. We have done this with a good amount of abilities that is in your disposal.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/b0f6c5e35bfee873c1a5088b621ed498173ad112.png[/img]

[h3][b]SO OVER DRAMATIC![/b][/h3]

As you take a Murkors health away they can look pretty angry, but what happens if they run out of health. well we have an animation for when the die which can look pretty dramatic. 


[h3][b]MORE TO COME![/b][/h3]

We will continue to frequently update you on our road to 1.0 and if you would like to see some exclusive content head over to our Discord server!

https://discord.gg/vseKzEQg

[b]Until again Defenders![/b]

notes.title: Die After Sunset - The Road To 1.0!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome Back Defenders![/h1]

Since our latest Murker invasion, we have taken the time to look at all your feedback and suggestions. Tinkering with new gameplay changes, design choices and difficulty. So, we would like to introduce to you what we are calling: [b]The Road to 1.0![/b]

[u][h2]AIM DOWN SIGHTS[/h2][/u]
To start off our road to 1.0, we’re shining a light on the new aim down sight mechanic! We feel it works way better for the moment-to-moment gunplay – especially when Murkors are further away. This will make shooting a lot more accurate and feel more immersive. A bonus advantage as well is that you get to see our beautiful graphics better as well!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/95135dd94f64eab8c0d62299a372fa2b26282cb1.gif[/img]


[u][h2]MORE TO COME![/h2][/u]
This is just a taste of many changes that we have made and we will continue to update you as they happen. *Can you spot them in our GIF's?*


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/8fb8c89200e5729f2cbc28c4134e73c0406ac7d1.gif[/img]


[u][h2]PLAYTEST WHEN?[/h2][/u]
Want to try out the new changes? Keep an eye out in the coming weeks for our first playtest! And for those eager defenders out there, make sure to join our Discord for exclusive content and info. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ef8f892476fbc867bfdcd1d4151e70112560ef00.gif[/img]

[b]We hope to see you there![/b]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/0903e4cafee1161ce057c3e41221a97e3edaee41.png[/img]

[b]Hi folks![/b]

We are continually working to improve our game day by day and all your feedback is greatly appreciated! It is so wonderful to see all your videos, streams and content around our game and we really do love to hear from you. 

Every week we're giving you detailed insight into what the current known issues are and which ones have been fixed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/4e67ced2bfe3aecae7d5c04a6d527e7eabed1528.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Performance issues, framerate improvements	(improved, but we are continuously working on this)

[b][*] [strike]Texture render improvements[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]Free muffin causing crashes[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]Level 1: Player can get stuck inside the boat[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]Level 1:Player getting stuck where the Murkraken spawns[/strike][/b]
[b][*] [strike]Level 1: Events can collide with scenario near the dock[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]Level 2: Fixing fall area that can get the player blocked[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]Level 3: Fixing bridge area causing player getting stuck[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]Level 3 boss: Player can get stuck inside the boss geometry[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]April icons for alternative weapons doesn't appear in game.[/strike][/b] 
[b][*] [strike]Text overflow on options/video[/strike]	[/b] 
[*] Crystals melting animation doesn't appear.	
		
[b][*] [strike]Rebinding keys makes some inputs unavailable[/strike][/b] 
[*] Interacting with objects can take the shooting inputs from the player	
		
[*] Game is not adapted for wide screens but can be selected as configuration		
	
[*] Full screen toggle is not working properly			

[b][*] [strike]Giant anomaly murkors getting stuck inside the cargo[/strike][/b]
[b][*] [strike]Puzzle altar pieces fall through the floor making them unavailable[/strike][/b] 
[/list]	

It's safe to say, we've been busy! Thanks to all your feedback we've improved texture rendering and crushed bugs throughout levels 1-3. Work has been made into smoothing out the performance of the game - which we know lots of you are reporting in. We've made some improvements this week, and are  doubling down week on week to address frame rate issues.

There's a few extra bits of feedback that have been pushed slightly out of this week's patch. Adapting the game for wide screens and working on the full screen toggle is still on our list for next week. Stay locked into the steam page next week for even more updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/84e9c34c421548f20f64afe6966a5464a1f33a74.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

We can't believe after all this time, we've finally released our game to the public. 
It's been a long road, but seeing all of your videos, streams, comments and reviews has been great. We cannot understate how grateful we are to everyone who's supported the game and provided feedback. 

What you have to say is so important to us - especially during this early access period, and we're working hard to make sure we address all of your comments to make Die After Sunset the best it could possibly be. 

Stay tuned every Friday for a 'Friday Fixes' post - giving you detailed insight into what the current known issues are and which ones have been fixed!

notes.title: Early Access Available to Download Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ca3d85533c2be4efd0a086a4ed9ed8bdde1567c2.png[/img]

[b]Happy launch day! [/b]

Today is the day folks, the [b]Early Access version for Die After Sunset is now available to download![/b] We're so happy to finally unleash Die After Sunset into Steam's Early Access program and look forward to your comments and feedback on the game!

See our Early Access Launch Trailer here:
[previewyoutube=-M27Rfes8h4;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoy the game - please be sure to leave us a review on Steam. It helps us massively and is the best way to support development! 

Let us know if you run into any issues during Early Access with [url=https://forms.gle/owNE84sppFWgvz789]our bug report form![/url]

[b]We dawn onto early access with:[/b]
[list]
[*] Two playable characters, two very different playstyles! Play as the pistol wielding, sharp-shooting, time travelling, April! Or assume the role of Rido, a submachine gun-wielding test subject, GONE WRONG!

[*] Three unique levels and bosses! The fight doesn't stop at Waikiki Beach... Battle vicious bosses on Treasure Island and Mock Town too!

[*] Dozens of items and power ups... Manipulate gravity to change the tide of battles with the gravity grenade or find your own personal drone to even the score! There's dozens of items and power ups to experiment with.

[*] Multiple missions to undertake and help you gain items you'll need to fight colossal bosses!

[*] More to come! Multiple updates adding everything from co-op gameplay to brand new characters and levels are all planned for the coming months.

[*] 20% off launch week. Grab a great deal with Die After Sunset launching at a discounted price of £9.99 / €11.99 / $11.99!
[/list]

So, what's new in this Early Access, we hear you ask?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/5c6e782c18b489d56fa534375a9d894e7fc14199.png[/img]

[h2][b]This is just the start![/b][/h2]
Our early access release is just the start of plenty of things to come. Over the next three months we will be adding new levels, characters, items, missions and constantly tweaking Die After Sunset with the help of community feedback. [url=https://discord.gg/mkYjpA63]Join our discord to give your feedback and help shape the future of development! [/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/aba83934e54baa09c7bb93ee9eb6075c2c128b02.png[/img]

March Kicks off with a brand new level to explore, with a terrifying new boss to fight at the end of it. You'll be armed with a couple of new missions to undertake; helping you get the best build possible before the dreaded sunset. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/24079cba63c70dcdf482d4c2f5349017e2e8122a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/a7c5926342aa0e95126377158ed27f5bb731f311.png[/img]

And then... there was three. Brand new character 'Hune' joins April and Rido to make for three playable characters to choose from! Hune's playstyle is, different, to say the least. Keep an eye out in March to learn a little more about her! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/eae12c43fdf836fe1ea66e6526061a785a459601.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/e35a57e68a0cdacec7a1f66bd0f06052676db4de.png[/img]

In May, you'll go head-to-head with NegaMurk...
The alien creature that is responsible for the attack on Earth. Take on the game's final boss in a brand new level that'll test your skills to the limits. 

To make matters worse, a brand new Murkor-type plagues the map. Luckily, you'll have a new batch of missions to help power yourself up to help tackle this new infestation! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/9918bbd0d6860dbbebcec699af177ed113ebe641.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #006
notes.content:
Well well well, it's been a while.

We have been loving watching everyone cause utter chaos in the playtest. Thank you for all bending, breaking and beating up those pesky lil Murkors. We appreciate that there are some teething problems with the demo build, and that some of you are having issues - so thank you for your patience and understand why we try get to the bottom of them all. 

We made a small patch yesterday, here's a couple of notes from it:
[list]
    [*]Fixed issues upon killing the Murkraken
    [*]Issues with some quests not unlocking
[/list]

Since you guys have been so lovely and understanding over on our [url=https://discord.gg/XEnXkugduT]Discord[/url] we've decided to treat you. We're extending the playtest period for a few days, [b]and will now finish on 7th of September rather than 30th August[/b]! Don't say we're not good to you. 

Next week, we'll give you a run down of what we've been working on in-game, and perhaps share some sneaky behind the scenes for you.
Until next time...and remember, don't eat yellow snow.

notes.title: Devlog #005
notes.content:
What's shakin', bacon?

Sorry we've been quite, its been a hectic couple of weeks at Playstark and PQube, with lots of changes and development updates happening in tandem. Here's what we've been up to!

First, the incredible Tom Waterhouse at [url=https://twitter.com/2dforever]2D Forever[/url] has redesigned our key art - and we couldn't be happier with it. It encapsulates the game perfectly, and is such a spectacular piece of art. Thanks again Tom, you rule. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/de729733979543b1549c627e640125c57a619431.jpg[/img]

On development, we've been hard at work with the 3rd new level - its Christmas in Mock Town! A stark contrast from the first two levels, it's time to round up those scoundrel Murkors and show this town who the real sherrif is. 
[h3][b]YEEHAW.[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/dd65a3381aca8ac302a6ac6f9f23e47c7f657f48.png[/img]
[i][b]It's Christmas of 1849 - and someone real annoying has been stealing toys. [/b][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/aa94b5d1cb5eed94b8b50693ec7ea113ca335297.png[/img]
[i][b]You've yee'd your last haw, partner.[/b][/i]

As always, we've been adding a ton of new items that vary up each run. Ontop of new skills, weapons and abilities, we're adding in new stat changes that can drop. Shield regen speed, elemental resistance, skill and weapon coooldown, speed, damage block.....you get the idea.
The aim is always to make each run feel new and unique, so adding in a variety of new stat changes mid-run helps this, as well as allows for greater build diversity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/768f19df648e42314a766949e2fbfb96057fab02.png[/img]

We've been adding in some variance to run missions and quests, adding in new occourances in each level. This should keep you all nice and busy while you're getting murdered by adorable Murkors. Or while you figure out whatever on Earth is going on with this.....
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/98c1038506b27073c772668d086859b5550704a1.jpg[/img]

We've also been hard at work creating the new character and how that will operate in the world. We want to ensure play and build diversity, as well as synergy between players - so we are working hard at making sure new characters feel unique and different from one another. From different skill kits and weapon loadouts, to different roles in battle. We're trying out a variety of options to make sure we settle on something great. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/c95f0a97b6ef4836ffa68b5865108272128fca70.jpg[/img]

Finally, we want to let you all start creating some chaos in the world - so we're happy to announce we will be [b]realeasing a free demo starting on August 20th![/b] This demo will be accessible on the Steam page, and will only be showcasing the first level of the game. We want to let you all go hands on with Die After Sunset, so this short demo should give you a taste of whats availavble. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/feec0f0d58027a7af5b5e07526406f1da5aefe63.png[/img]

Aren't we the best to you guys? Awk, you don't have to say that. But if you do wan't to tell us how great we are, come do it in our [url=https://discord.gg/XEnXkugduT]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/PlaystarkGames]Twitter[/url].

Meet you there!

As always, we've been adding a ton of new items that vary up each run.
Ontop of new skills, weapons and abilities, we're adding in new stat changes that can drop.
We've been adding in some variance to run missions and quests, adding in new occourances in each level.
We've also been hard at work creating the new character and how that will operate in the world.
Finally, we want to let you all start creating some chaos in the world - so we're happy to announce we will be realeasing a free demo starting on August 20th!

notes.title: Devlog #003
notes.content:
Hey guys, happy Monday! I hope you all have killer weeks ahead of you.

This devlog comes a little late, as things have been hectic this past week. A lot of final checks and balances had to be completed before our beta went live on Friday - which was a lot of work. We've seen so many of you create amazing content from the beta so far and will be highlighting some of it later in the week - so keep busting out some crazy runs and submit your clips, screenshots and memes into the [url=https://discord.gg/XEnXkugduT]Discord[/url]!

Outside of everything in the beta, we've been creating ideas for a bunch of new in-game quests. During your runs, procedural quests will pop up around the map which can be completed, or not, at your choosing. The better (and sometimes quicker!) you complete these quests, the better your reward. From little stat bumps, to time-warping grenades or cat turrets that rain hell on the Murkors - these rewards can sometimes take your run to the next level!

We have a bunch of quests already in the game, with a bunch more on the way. Let's check 'em out.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/dcd76992cb186a550d49d273b6c8e039e646c8dc.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Bathing suit robbery. The WORST kind of robbery. [/b][/i]

In this event, the Murkors are rushing from the beach shacks to the teleporter to steal swimming costumes. How RUDE. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/da6e6829e085148f3a8f7e13303ceebae2c22502.jpg[/img]
[i][b]Can we get some more light in here?[/b][/i]

This one is already in the game, but its great. When you learn how to do this one a couple of times, its an easy win for a 3 star completion to get that tasty tasty loot. Power up the generator and get some light back in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/32a5528fb3021ee223e9d3d3e27e08e532285e29.jpg[/img]
[i][b]This one is just....cool looking.[/b][/i]

What could this one be? Even I don't know what this one is. How mysterious!!

If any of this looks exciting to you, [url=https://pqube.co.uk/die-after-sunset/]sign up to be apart of our future playtests[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/XEnXkugduT]join our community[/url], and come and get stuck in the floor before we fix it. 
[h2]Rise up, pre bug-fix gang!!!
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40784820/ded44f5456e0f18f7a1e7a65d9e4713a2bfdee12.png[/img] 

We're loving all of the content we're seeing come out of the beta, so keep it coming, and we'll be checking in on it all this coming Friday in Devlog 4!!
Stay out the shade, legends.
